artist.name: Pia Collada
artist.bio: Pia Collada is a Goa-based bass DJ who grew up across India, the USA and Tanzania and moved to Goa from Delhi. She is a resident at Worldwide FM, where she hosts Global Wav, and founded BASS WAV, a platform for women and femme DJs and artists. She has played Glastonbury, Shambala and Magnetic Fields.

eras.sound: Bass-heavy club music with hip hop, reggae and afro
